verdict.rationale: Docs confirm Obsidian's core linking model ("[[wiki-style]]" internal links create a network of knowledge, and links to non-existent notes auto-create them) plus a Graph view for visualizing note relationships, and community feedback confirms the graph feature works (though seen as "gimmicky" by one user). However, the evidence pack never explicitly documents a backlinks pane or an 'unlinked mentions' panel showing context. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the Backlinks panel and Unlinked Mentions feature showing surrounding text context.
